issues.reason: *Categorical statements* makes the determiner decisive — a definite plural ("all the local waters") "takes a group witness — (GroupOf <group> <kind>)" — so the singular (Member sk_waters_1 water) is the wrong encoding for a plural referent.

"A property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol ... a descriptive modifier or copular predicate on a plural always goes through the distributive rule", and `local` is not a property of the collection itself (size, name).

The QuantifierPhrase half stands — the instruction set requires the companion "only when a quantifier word is actually there" and its absence is what marks a bare generic, so dropping "all" makes this indistinguishable from "fished out the local waters"; the per-member-distribution half does not, since the reviewer's own q2 gap concedes the universal-distribution machinery is specified for subjects and rule ranges, not for a universally quantified definite object.

A bare-plural verbal subject is routed to a distributing generic rule by the instruction set itself ("Foxes rarely cross the causeway" is the same shape, definite object witness included), so the cumulative/episodic reading the reviewer wants is the coverage gap it separately files, not a parse defect.

gaps_confirmed: No cumulative / episodic reading for a bare-plural subject in a perfect-tense clause — every bare-plural verbal subject is routed to a distributing generic rule.
An explicit universal in OBJECT position ("V-ed all the Ns") has no specified distribution machinery; only subjects and rule ranges are covered.
new_gaps: QuantifierPhrase's slots are defined for a quantified rule range (kind + verb-lemma, or a group premise's kind); there is no defined form for an explicit quantifier on a definite-group OBJECT that no rule ranges over, so the companion emitted here is a free-floating surface record.
repair_summary: Re-encoded the definite plural "all the local waters" as a group witness (GroupOf sk_waters_1 water) in place of the singular (Member sk_waters_1 water); replaced the group-level (Member sk_waters_1 local) with the licensed distribution rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_waters_1) (Member $x local)) (STV 1.0 0.9); added the (QuantifierPhrase water fish_out "all") companion recording the dropped quantifier word.
notes: The subject-side generic rule, the fishing_trawler genus with the noun modifier unexposed, and the whole-kept phrasal verb fish_out are left untouched. The object universal is not distributed, because that construction is genuinely uncovered.
